=== base-generic full
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Lusoris Imageless Provisioning Script
# Target Flavor: base-generic (Base Generic)
# Generated automatically by imago
set -euo pipefail

echo "==> Initiating Lusoris imageless flavor application..."
echo "==> Flavor: base-generic | Hardware Stack: VirtIO / Generic CPU"

# Environment configuration
export FLAVOR="base-generic"
export KERNEL_PROFILE="generic"

# Execution pipeline
echo "==> Executing provisioner: 00-base-strip.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/00-base-strip.sh" ]; then
  bash "packer/provisioners/00-base-strip.sh"
else
  echo "    Warning: provisioner 00-base-strip.sh not found in local workspace"
fi

echo "==> Executing provisioner: 05-hypervisor-agents.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/05-hypervisor-agents.sh" ]; then
  bash "packer/provisioners/05-hypervisor-agents.sh"
else
  echo "    Warning: provisioner 05-hypervisor-agents.sh not found in local workspace"
fi

echo "==> Executing provisioner: 10-network-time.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/10-network-time.sh" ]; then
  bash "packer/provisioners/10-network-time.sh"
else
  echo "    Warning: provisioner 10-network-time.sh not found in local workspace"
fi

echo "==> Executing provisioner: 20-kernel-sysctl.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/20-kernel-sysctl.sh" ]; then
  bash "packer/provisioners/20-kernel-sysctl.sh"
else
  echo "    Warning: provisioner 20-kernel-sysctl.sh not found in local workspace"
fi

echo "==> Executing provisioner: 25-baremetal-tuning.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/25-baremetal-tuning.sh" ]; then
  bash "packer/provisioners/25-baremetal-tuning.sh"
else
  echo "    Warning: provisioner 25-baremetal-tuning.sh not found in local workspace"
fi

echo "==> Executing provisioner: 99-cleanup.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/99-cleanup.sh" ]; then
  bash "packer/provisioners/99-cleanup.sh"
else
  echo "    Warning: provisioner 99-cleanup.sh not found in local workspace"
fi

echo "==> Imageless flavor application complete."

# Target Flavor: k8s-node-calico (K8s Node Calico)
# Generated automatically by imago
set -euo pipefail

echo "==> Initiating Lusoris imageless flavor application..."
echo "==> Flavor: k8s-node-calico | Hardware Stack: VirtIO / CPU"

# Environment configuration
export FLAVOR="k8s-node-calico"
export KERNEL_PROFILE="k8s"
export PREHEAT_PROFILE="calico"

# Execution pipeline
echo "==> Executing provisioner: 00-base-strip.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/00-base-strip.sh" ]; then
  bash "packer/provisioners/00-base-strip.sh"
else
  echo "    Warning: provisioner 00-base-strip.sh not found in local workspace"
fi

echo "==> Executing provisioner: 05-hypervisor-agents.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/05-hypervisor-agents.sh" ]; then
  bash "packer/provisioners/05-hypervisor-agents.sh"
else
  echo "    Warning: provisioner 05-hypervisor-agents.sh not found in local workspace"
fi

echo "==> Executing provisioner: 10-network-time.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/10-network-time.sh" ]; then
  bash "packer/provisioners/10-network-time.sh"
else
  echo "    Warning: provisioner 10-network-time.sh not found in local workspace"
fi

echo "==> Executing provisioner: 20-kernel-sysctl.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/20-kernel-sysctl.sh" ]; then
  bash "packer/provisioners/20-kernel-sysctl.sh"
else
  echo "    Warning: provisioner 20-kernel-sysctl.sh not found in local workspace"
fi

echo "==> Executing provisioner: 25-baremetal-tuning.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/25-baremetal-tuning.sh" ]; then
  bash "packer/provisioners/25-baremetal-tuning.sh"
else
  echo "    Warning: provisioner 25-baremetal-tuning.sh not found in local workspace"
fi

echo "==> Executing provisioner: 50-k8s-runtime.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/50-k8s-runtime.sh" ]; then
  bash "packer/provisioners/50-k8s-runtime.sh"
else
  echo "    Warning: provisioner 50-k8s-runtime.sh not found in local workspace"
fi

echo "==> Executing provisioner: 55-k8s-precache.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/55-k8s-precache.sh" ]; then
  bash "packer/provisioners/55-k8s-precache.sh"
else
  echo "    Warning: provisioner 55-k8s-precache.sh not found in local workspace"
fi

echo "==> Executing provisioner: 99-cleanup.sh"
if [ -f "packer/provisioners/99-cleanup.sh" ]; then

  echo "    Warning: provisioner 99-cleanup.sh not found in local workspace"
